title: Clinical AI conversation transcript (import format), draft 0.1
description: One conversation per JSON object, one object per line in a .jsonl file. Text is the only content field; everything else is provenance, de-identification state, and annotations. A record whose deidentification.status is not one of the allowed values is invalid and the importer refuses it; the value 'identified' is deliberately absent from the enum so that identified material can never validate.

conversation_id.description: Opaque, stable, and not derived from any identifier of a person (a random id or a hash of the de-identified text).

system.description: The deploying organisation's label for the assistant, e.g. a product or pilot name. Never a person.

model_version.description: Exact version string the provider returned, if the capture had it.

method.description: Tool or procedure used; null only for synthetic.

reviewed_by.description: Role of the human who confirmed the de-identification (a role, not a name); null only for synthetic.

basis.description: Legal or ethical basis for research use (e.g. an IRB determination reference), as a label.

user_is.description: Who the human turns come from. The study's contrast is between patient-framed and clinician-framed wording of the same situation; this field records which the conversation is, so paired analysis can match across conversations.

attachments_omitted.description: Count of non-text items dropped at import (images, files). Recorded, never silently dropped.

topic.description: Coarse topic label from the study's specialty map, if assigned.

value.description: One of that dimension's declared values.

annotator.description: Rule name, judge model version, or a human role label.

importer_sha.description: Git sha of the importer that wrote this record.

text_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of `turns`, so a later edit to the text is detectable.
